messages:
Carter Jin: Heads-up  saw a cluster of Growth accounts drop out of 'activated' band overnight. No product incident, but onboarding completion rates look lower.
Nia Kaur: Saw the same on the dashboard. Correlates with yesterday's launch of the self-serve setup flow (v1)  product changed the final call-to-action from "start-trial" to "finish-setup".
Omar Ruiz: That CTA name change is fine, but playbook triggers were expecting event_type = 'start_trial'. If the new event is 'finish_setup' nothing fires.
Carter Jin: Right  our activation_score increments +12 on start_trial. New finish_setup currently emits no trigger, so scores drop.
Nia Kaur: Options: 1) revert CTA name in product (bad UX), 2) patch playbook to accept finish_setup, 3) emit a synthetic start_trial event for compatibility via a backfill for recent accounts. Prefer compat + mapping change.
Omar Ruiz: Agree. We'll: A) backfill recent accounts that only have finish_setup to emit start_trial-compatible trigger, B) update scoring mapping so finish_setup maps to +10 (slightly lower weight than old start_trial) with a note, C) add a CI guard to prevent breaking compatibility on event name changes.
Carter Jin: Acceptance: net activated accounts should not drop more than 0.5% for Growth cohort after change; for the backfill, attach CSM note explaining automated compatibility restore.
playbook-bot: Created task cs/playbooks/compat/finish-setup-compat (#1203).
Omar Ruiz: SQL to find candidates for backfill:
```
SELECT account_id
FROM onboarding_events
WHERE event_type = 'finish_setup'
  AND created_at >= now() - interval '21 days'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM health_triggers ht
    WHERE ht.account_id = onboarding_events.account_id
      AND ht.trigger_type = 'start_trial'
  );
```
We'll generate idempotency key: md5(account_id || '-compat-starttrial-202605'). Throttle 30/s.
Nia Kaur: Also add rule: when mapping event names, require a one-line compatibility justification in any playbook PR that changes event types. CI should fail if a change to event_type is detected without the justification tag.
Carter Jin: Omar, can you run a small staging backfill and post counts?
Omar Ruiz: Kicked off staging backfill (run id compat-stg-2310). Staging results: scanned 980 accounts, emitted 742 synthetic start_trial triggers, skipped 238 (already had start_trial).
CS-AutoBot: Staging health counts pre/backfill/after: {"activated": 2,340 -> 2,338 -> 2,980, "onboarding_in_progress": 1,120 -> 1,320 -> 640, "inactive": 210 -> 220 -> 180}
Nia Kaur: Those shifts look healthy. Omar, please open PR for scoring config: map finish_setup -> +10 when finish_setup occurs within 7d of first_login, otherwise +4. Include A/B 10% for 14 days.
Omar Ruiz: PR opened: infra/cs/score-finish-setup (#689). Includes scoring patch, compatibility backfill runner, and a CI test that scans diffs in health rollups for 90-day history.
Carter Jin: Acceptance checklist: 1) staging run passes, 2) PR includes compatibility justification, 3) CSM notes template created for backfill, 4) A/B plan documented.
playbook-bot: CSM note template created at /playbooks/cs/compat-notes/finish-setup-compat. Tagged #csm-ops.
Omar Ruiz: Scheduling prod backfill for 2026-05-20T02:30Z with throttle 30/s and idempotency keys.
Nia Kaur: Also require that any change to event names in product include a small migration plan and a pointer to playbook owners in the PR description. We'll add that to the release checklist.
Carter Jin: Good. Omar, when you run prod please paste the healthscore diff here.
playbook-bot: Prod backfill job queued: compat-backfill v1.0 -> prod (job id compat-prod-2310).
Omar Ruiz: Prod run completed: processed 3,820 accounts, emitted 3,196 synthetic start_trial triggers, skipped 624.
CS-AutoBot: Prod health counts pre/backfill/after: {"activated": 7,890 -> 7,740 -> 8,995, "onboarding_in_progress": 3,100 -> 4,140 -> 1,270, "inactive": 540 -> 560 -> 400}
Nia Kaur: Post-prod diffs look good. Activated up by ~13.2k? wait the numbers are counts not thousands. Activated net +1,255 which is within acceptance.
Carter Jin: Great. Omar, did the backfill attach notes and upload CSV?
Omar Ruiz: Yes  CSV uploaded to s3://ops/cs/compat-backfills/2310001234-finishsetup-prod.csv (3,820 rows). CSM notes attached to each modified account.
playbook-bot: Compatibility justification missing in historical PRs detected by CI for a prior product change. Created tech debt ticket cs/compat/missing-justifications (#1210).
Nia Kaur: We'll triage that ticket. Also adding a small monitor: if any event_type usage changes by >15% week-over-week, alert product+CS owners so we review mapping.
Carter Jin: Follow-ups: 1) merge scoring PR and A/B rollout plan, 2) add migration checklist to product release docs, 3) run a retrospective on why the event name change wasn't coordinated earlier.
Omar Ruiz: Merged PR (#689). A/B rollout scheduled for 10% of Growth cohort starting 2026-05-22.
Nia Kaur: Thanks team. Closing loop unless we see anomalies in A/B.
playbook-bot: Closing task cs/playbooks/compat/finish-setup-compat (#1203).
